items.title: S.A.P.T.A
items.decryption: Sannidhata (Treasurer), Adhyaksha (Superintendent), Pradeshika (Revenue/District), Tirthas (High Officials), Akshapatala (Audit/Record Office).

traps.title: UPSC Common Exam Traps
items: Mistaking Mauryan 'Adhyakshas' for purely military officers; they were primarily economic and trade supervisors.
Assuming provincial administration was uniform; it varied significantly between the core (Magadha) and frontier provinces.
Confusing 'Rajukas' (originally land surveyors) with later Mauryan judicial officials under Ashoka.

sections.title: 1. Core Study Notes
sections.content:
Central Nodes

  • Mantriparishad (Council of Ministers)
  • Tirthas (18 High Offices)
  • Adhyakshas (27+ Superintendents)

Provincial Tier

  • Kumara (Viceroy)
  • Pradesikas (Administrative heads)
  • Rajukas (Surveyors/Judges)
  • Key Offices Defined:
    • Samaharta: Chief Collector of Revenue; responsible for all income.
    • Sannidhata: Chief Treasurer; in charge of state treasury and storehouses.
    • Adhyakshas: Superintendents controlling departments like mining, agriculture, commerce, and weights.
